notes: Foundation GREEN-gate scenarios for SKILL-1 substrate. Trust-state values are persisted UPPERCASE (SELF_REPORTED|MANAGER_APPROVED|VERIFIED) per Page 03 §3.1; the authored e2e stubs use hyphen-case and are bridged by a value map (TACTICAL-ADR-01). Claude client is INJECTED as a double in tests; no live API call. Tests run against a disposable seeded SQLite DB, never the shared dev.db.

scenarios.title: Vitest harness runs and finds no foundation tests yet
scenarios.given: a fresh feature/SKILL-1-foundation checkout with no tests/ dir
scenarios.when: pnpm test runs
scenarios.then: Vitest executes and reports zero test files (honest pre-state); db:push applies the 6 starter models; typecheck + lint clean

phases.name: Schema extension, synthetic seed, fixtures, doc/env reconcile (SUB-TASK-1)

scenarios.title: Extended schema applies via db:push with starter invariants intact
scenarios.given: the extended prisma/schema.prisma
scenarios.when: pnpm db:push runs and the client is regenerated to lib/generated/prisma
scenarios.then: the 6 starter models persist with EmployeeSkill @@unique([employeeId,skillId]), Enrollment @@unique, Skill.name @unique and the leadId self-relation intact; new models Resume/UpskillingPlan/PlanItem/IdentityMapping exist; Skill.canonicalKey @unique, Certificate/Resume @@unique([employeeId,contentHash]), UpskillingPlan @@unique([employeeId]), IdentityMapping.syntheticHandle @unique are declared
scenarios.test_function: schema applies with all unique constraints

scenarios.title: Seed produces 20-25 profiles with baseline skills + availability
scenarios.given: a fresh seeded disposable DB
scenarios.when: the synthetic seed runs with the fixed RNG seed
scenarios.then: 20-25 Employee rows exist, each carrying >=1 EmployeeSkill with origin=BASELINE/trustState=SELF_REPORTED, an allocation (0-100), a freeFrom (mix past/+2wk/future), seniority and timezone (some IST)
scenarios.test_function: every seeded profile has baseline skills + freeFrom + allocation

scenarios.title: Catalog seeded with aiEnabled deliberately set (>=1 true)
scenarios.given: a seeded catalog of ~12-20 items
scenarios.when: the catalog is inspected
scenarios.then: every CatalogItem.aiEnabled is a real boolean and at least one is true (so the downstream plan-gate can be satisfied)
scenarios.test_function: catalog has aiEnabled set with at least one true

scenarios.title: One synthetic IdentityMapping per employee, no real PII
scenarios.given: a seeded DB
scenarios.when: IdentityMapping rows are inspected
scenarios.then: one mapping per employee keyed by a synthetic handle (handle-prefixed), never a real email/PII
scenarios.test_function: identity mappings keyed by synthetic handles only

scenarios.title: Seed never emits real-domain emails or PII
scenarios.given: all seeded Employee.name/email
scenarios.when: scanned by the no-PII gate
scenarios.then: no value matches a real-domain pattern (gmail/yahoo/outlook/hotmail etc.); emails are synthetic *.test or example.* only

phases.name: Claude boundary, prompts/schemas scaffold, repository path (SUB-TASK-2)

scenarios.title: Wrapper returns Ok(typed) on valid model output
scenarios.given: callClaude with a per-call Zod schema and an injected client returning a valid scripted JSON payload
scenarios.when: the response passes through the wrapper
scenarios.then: schema.safeParse succeeds and a typed Ok(data) is returned; the call boundary was invoked exactly once

scenarios.title: Wrapper returns Failure and writes nothing on garbled JSON
scenarios.given: an injected client returning malformed JSON (makeClaudeClientGarbled equivalent)
scenarios.when: the response passes through the wrapper
scenarios.then: extractStructuredBlock + safeParse fail and a typed Failure(promptName, requestId) is returned; nothing is persisted; no raw model text reaches a write path

scenarios.title: Wrapper maps an SDK throw to Failure
scenarios.given: an injected client whose createMessage throws (network/5xx/rate-limit)
scenarios.when: callClaude is invoked
scenarios.then: the throw is caught at the boundary and mapped to a typed Failure; it never bubbles raw to a write path; logged with requestId

scenarios.title: Sub-threshold confidence is treated as Failure
scenarios.given: a schema-valid payload whose confidence is below threshold
scenarios.when: callClaude validates it
scenarios.then: the wrapper returns Failure (write nothing), consistent with the AC-03/06/20 single rule

scenarios.title: Model routing: Opus only for match-staffing; ids from config
scenarios.given: the route(complexity) function and config-provided model ids
scenarios.when: route('hard') and route('routine') are called
scenarios.then: route('hard') returns the Opus id and route('routine') returns the Sonnet id; no model id is hardcoded inside business logic
scenarios.test_function: route maps complexity to configured model ids

scenarios.title: Aliases collapse to one canonical Skill id
scenarios.given: a seeded alias mapping where TS resolves to TypeScript's canonicalKey
scenarios.when: resolveCanonicalSkill('TypeScript') and resolveCanonicalSkill('TS') are called
scenarios.then: both return the same canonical Skill.id (deterministic Layer 1 key, Claude Layer 2 as advisor only)
scenarios.test_function: TypeScript and TS resolve to one canonical id

scenarios.title: upsertAndPromoteSkill promotes in place, never demotes, never duplicates
scenarios.given: a profile already holding a canonical skill at SELF_REPORTED (or MANAGER_APPROVED)
scenarios.when: upsertAndPromoteSkill is called with a higher targetState, then again with an equal-or-lower targetState
scenarios.then: the first call promotes the SAME row (sets trustState + promotedAt), the second is a no-op that never demotes, and only one EmployeeSkill row exists for (employeeId, canonicalSkillId)

scenarios.title: skill-identity failure falls back to create-new, write never blocks (TS-002)
scenarios.given: resolveCanonicalSkill with a Layer-2 skill-identity call that fails/returns invalid schema
scenarios.when: a new (non-aliased) skill name is resolved
scenarios.then: the path falls back to create-new keyed by the deterministic canonicalKey + markReconcilePending(key); a new canonical Skill.id is returned; the write completes without throwing or hanging

phases.name: Vitest harness, single-file command, foundation tests + no-PII gate (SUB-TASK-3)

scenarios.title: Schema-invariant foundation test green on seeded DB
scenarios.given: a freshly seeded disposable DB
scenarios.when: TypeScript and TS are resolved and a second upsertAndPromoteSkill runs for the same (profile, skill)
scenarios.then: exactly one canonical Skill.id and exactly one EmployeeSkill row result (Scenario D)

scenarios.title: No-PII gate scans seed + fixtures + env-secrets
scenarios.given: loadSeedProfiles(), scanRepoForHardcodedSecrets(), secretEnvVarNames() from lib/dev/guardrails
scenarios.when: the gate runs
scenarios.then: each object returned by loadSeedProfiles() exposes ONLY the no-PII-safe projection (handle + email, with synthetic handle-prefixed handles and no real-domain emails) and contains NO name-like key (name is projected away even though the Employee row keeps its name column) (R2-03); no hardcoded secret literal in tracked source; secretEnvVarNames includes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and a GOOGLE...CLIENT...(ID|SECRET) name; .env.example holds placeholders only

scenarios.title: Wrapper validation-gate proves no write on bad output
scenarios.given: the wrapper with an injected SDK double
scenarios.when: fed a deliberately invalid payload then a valid one
scenarios.then: invalid -> Failure with nothing persisted; valid -> Ok(typed)

scenarios.title: Baseline-skills foundation test green
scenarios.given: the seeded profiles
scenarios.when: each profile is inspected
scenarios.then: every profile has >=1 origin=BASELINE skill plus a freeFrom and allocation; baseline distinct from any ACQUIRED skill

scenarios.title: Single-file test command runs one test in isolation
scenarios.given: the documented single-file command (pnpm test <file> -> vitest run <file>)
scenarios.when: invoked against one foundation test file
scenarios.then: only that file's tests run; a non-existent path surfaces a no-tests-found hint

scenarios.title: Tests never hit the live Anthropic API or the shared dev.db
scenarios.given: the Vitest globalSetup (tests/setup/global-db.ts) which, before any test module imports the Prisma client, overrides process.env.DATABASE_URL to a unique per-run temp file (file:./.tmp/test-<pid>-<ts>.db) and runs prisma db push + seed against it (CLI resolves the URL via prisma.config.ts); lib/repos/db.ts constructs the runtime client as new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL }) because the schema datasource has no url/env() and prisma.config.ts is CLI-only; and the per-test setup (tests/setup/db.ts) which guards that DATABASE_URL is set, is NOT file:./dev.db, and does not end in /dev.db
scenarios.when: the suite runs and a test re-seeds the DB
scenarios.then: the Claude client is an injected double (no live ANTHROPIC_API_KEY use; fail loudly if detected); the runtime PrismaClient is bound to the temp DB via its explicit datasourceUrl, so every read/write and re-seed hits the disposable temp DB, never the shared dev.db (the dev.db guard fails loudly if the override did not take, so a re-seed cannot false-green against dev.db); globalSetup teardown deletes the temp file
scenarios.test_function: isolated per-run DB (DATABASE_URL override + dev.db guard) + stubbed SDK
